content.text:
## Summary

Working in the existing worktree `/home/user/deepseek-harness/.claude/worktrees/agent-aba2ca0dc993adcd6` (branch `worktree-agent-aba2ca0dc993adcd6`), I completed the interrupted fix.

**Commit:** `4fd1863b03a1ec915941994d8ce27801416f9754` on `worktree-agent-aba2ca0dc993adcd6`, working tree clean.

### Reproduced failures

`verify-built-package-invariants` stages only `package.json#files`-listed `lib/` files, then imports `<pkg>/invariant` under plain Node — so a built `invariant.js` that imports an unlisted sibling chunk fails to resolve. Before my fix, that was true for two packages (the other four already had the previous agent's untracked configs in place, and I confirmed their pre-fix state via stale build artifacts predating those configs):

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-shifts: Cannot find module '.../packages/improvement/shifts/.dsh-built-invariant-.../lib/plan-DU4_syRw.js' imported from '.../lib/invariant.js'
@deepseek-ai/dsh-verification: Cannot find module '.../packages/verification/verification/.dsh-built-invariant-.../lib/isolation-CN2fvH6G.js' imported from '.../lib/invariant.js'
```

Stale (pre-fix) artifacts confirmed the identical cause for the other two new-config packages: `guard/budget-policy/lib/invariant.js` imported `./fold-CEQjQ5Sw.js`, `components/components-manifest/lib/invariant.js` imported `./fold-DLIdISad.js` — both predating the previous agent's tsdown.config.ts (mtime check). Root cause in every case: `index.ts` and `invariant.ts` both import the same local module (`./fold.ts`, `./plan.ts`, `./isolation.ts`), and the root `tsdown.config.ts`'s default multi-entry build (`entry: ['lib/types/index.js','lib/types/invariant.js', ...]`, one Rollup/Rolldown invocation) splits that shared code into a hashed chunk `files` never lists. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-program` was confirmed **not** affected — its `lib/` has only `index.js`/`invariant.js`, no shared chunk.

### Convention found and applied

The established, dominant remedy (already shipping in `packages/goal/goal-round-driver`, `packages/goal/goal`, `packages/core/{agent,agent-loop,agent-default-model,scope,session}`, `packages/context/time-context`, `packages/interaction/user-approval`, `packages/code-runtime/code-runtime-worker-thread`) is a package-local `tsdown.config.ts` that builds the root and invariant entries as **two separate single-entry configs** in one `defineConfig([...])` array — each build then inlines/duplicates the shared local module instead of splitting a chunk, needing no `package.json` change. I confirmed the previous agent's four untracked files matched this exact pattern byte-for-byte and were the correct remedy (not a wrong turn), then wrote two more identical files for the remaining failures. (I also found and rejected two alternatives: `outputOptions: { codeSplitting: false }`, used only by `compaction`/`jsonrpc-demo`, a minority style; and a source-level self-import trick in `packages/preset/agent-presets/src/invariant.ts`, which requires promoting internal helpers to public exports — unnecessary here.)

### Packages changed (all new `tsdown.config.ts`, no `src/**` or `package.json` edits)
- `packages/components/components-manifest/tsdown.config.ts` (pre-existing from interrupted attempt, verified correct)
- `packages/guard/budget-policy/tsdown.config.ts` (same)
- `packages/improvement/experiments/tsdown.config.ts` (same)
- `packages/improvement/scorekeeper/tsdown.config.ts` (same)
- `packages/improvement/shifts/tsdown.config.ts` (new, written this session)
- `packages/verification/verification/tsdown.config.ts` (new, written this session)

### Gates

| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| `pnpm install --offline` | pass |
| `pnpm run build` (host+client+web, run twice, incl. a fully clean cold rebuild) | pass, no errors |
| `pnpm run verify-built-package-invariants` | pass — `241 compiled companion(s) passed` (from a clean rebuild) |
| `pnpm run hygiene` | **fails only at `verify-runtime-closure`** (pre-existing, unrelated — see below). Every other sub-check passes: `rescope-vendor:check`, `knip` (silent), `check-workspace-constraints` (silent), `verify-dsh-package-licenses` (244 MIT), `verify-package-invariants` (241), `verify-built-package-invariants` (241), `verify-cordis-config` (149), `verify-village-composition` (149 passed, 1 pre-existing unrelated warning about a read-barrier fixture), `verify-node-next-types` (250). `publint` reports `pkg.exports["./src/*"] is ./src/* but does not match any files.` for essentially every one of the 241 packages, including all 6 touched ones — a repo-wide, pre-existing, non-fatal warning; it does **not** fail the step. `verify-vendored-links` never ran because the chain stopped earlier. |
| `pnpm run typecheck` | pass |
| `pnpm run knip` (standalone) | pass, silent |
| `vitest run` over the 6 touched packages | pass — 21 test files, 423 tests |
| `pnpm run clean` | ran twice (255 paths removed), tree confirmed to hold only the 6 new files before commit |

**Pre-existing, out-of-scope failure:** `verify-runtime-closure` reports missing workspace peers in `python/sdk-runtime` for `dsh-sandbox-policy -> dsh-read-barrier`, `dsh-skill -> dsh-components`, `dsh-tool-skill -> dsh-components`. This script only reads `package.json` manifests (confirmed by reading `scripts/verify-runtime-closure.ts`); I changed zero `package.json` files, and `git status` was clean against base commit `3b18c731b` before my edits, so this is provably pre-existing on the base commit — not caused by this fix, and it touches `dsh-read-barrier`/`dsh-skill`/`dsh-components`, none of which are in scope (and `read-barrier` is explicitly another agent's territory). I did not touch it.

### Not done / left as-is
- Did not fix `verify-runtime-closure` (out of scope, pre-existing, touches packages I was told not to own).
- No README or `docs/development.md` update: neither currently documents this specific shared-chunk shipping mechanism in a way my change would make stale (I checked the six touched packages' "Known Limitations" sections and the TypeScript-project-layout section of `docs/development.md`).
- No new Agent Note: this is a mechanical extension of an already-established, already-documented pattern (identical `tsdown.config.ts` shape already shipping in 8+ packages, failure mechanism already described in `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-19-package-invariant-runtime-contracts.md`), not a new architectural decision.
- No model name/identifier appears in any changed file or the commit message.
